title.narrative: Strengthening Digital Governance for Enhancing the Efficiency and Accountability of the Central Government of Ukraine

description.narrative: The project`s aim is to improve governance efficiency through digital tools for coordination, policy development, and decision monitoring. The key components of the Project are the following: (a) development and deployment of a digital project management system for the Government of Ukraine, ensuring a more structured and transparent decision-making process; (b) implementation of Diia for Civil Servants services, streamlining administrative workflows and enhancing digital interactions among government institutions; and (c) capacity development building for civil servants, equipping them with the necessary digital skills to effectively use modernized systems and ensure long-term sustainability.
